headlines.headline: STEPHEN CURRY AGREES TO 2-YEAR, $116M EXTENSION TO STAY WITH WARRIORS
headlines.detail: Deal runs through 2028-29, below the roughly $136 million he could have commanded; total current contract value now about $178.6 million. Dallas held media day previewing a Kyrie Irving-Cooper Flagg pairing, with camps opening league-wide Sept. 29.

headlines.headline: COWBOYS HEAD TO BRAZIL FOR NFL'S FIRST-EVER RIO GAME AS QB INJURY WAVE CONTINUES
headlines.detail: Dallas faces Lamar Jackson and the Ravens in the league's first regular-season game in Brazil. Bears could be without both Caleb Williams and Tyson Bagent; Giants placed Jaxson Dart on IR, reinstalling Jameis Winston as starter.

headlines.headline: NO. 1 TEXAS SURVIVES AT TENNESSEE 20-17 BEHIND FIVE-SACK PERFORMANCE
headlines.detail: Colin Simmons tied the program record with five sacks as Texas held off No. 14 Tennessee at Neyland Stadium, headlining a stacked Week 4 slate that also included Ole Miss-Florida and Colorado-Baylor.

headlines.headline: FLORIDA TOPS UPDATED PRESEASON TOP 25 AS TEAMS OPEN CAMP
headlines.detail: CBS Sports' 2026-27 preseason Top 25 And 1 has Florida at No. 1, followed by Duke, Michigan, Illinois and UConn, with Arkansas, Gonzaga, Texas and Arizona rounding out the top nine.
